possessionEndsWhen: a shot is deflected off the woodwork or another player
the referee significantly deflects the ball
the ball goes out of play
eventDefinitions.pass: possession changes between two players of the same team
eventDefinitions.shot: a player attempts a shot towards goal
eventDefinitions.cross: an aerial or outer-lane ground pass into the box intended to create a scoring opportunity
eventDefinitions.throughBall: a ground pass through opposing defenders to a teammate behind the defensive line
eventDefinitions.deepBall: a pass to set up a teammate behind the defensive line
eventDefinitions.blockedShot: a goal-bound shot is significantly deflected by a non-last-line defender
eventDefinitions.savedShot: the goalkeeper or last line defender averts an on-target shot
eventDefinitions.challenge: players engage for possession or to disrupt one another with roughly equal chance at initiation
